// Asset source is ordinary compiled Chibi. These values describe the document
// passed to each asset family's validator; they do not perform external work.
pub Value :: union {
    Null | Bool(value: bool) | Int(value: int64) | UInt(value: uint64)
    | Real(value: double) | Text(value: string)
    | Array(values: Value[]) | Object(keys: string[], values: Value[])
}

pub Field :: union { Named(name: string, value: Value) }

pub Object :: (fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    keys: string[] = [];
    values: Value[] = [];
    for (field in fields) {
        switch field {
            case .Named(name, value):
                for (previous in keys) {
                    assert(previous != name, "Duplicate asset object field");
                }
                keys.append(name);
                values.append(value);
        }
    }
    return Value.Object(keys, values);
}

pub List :: (values: Value[]) -> Value {
    return Value.Array(values);
}

pub Get :: (object: Value, name: string) -> Value {
    switch object {
        case .Object(keys, values):
            assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
            index: int = 0;
            while (index < length(keys)) {
                if (keys[index] == name) { return values[index]; }
                index += 1;
            }
        case .Null: assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
        case .Bool(value): assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
        case .Int(value): assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
        case .UInt(value): assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
        case .Real(value): assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
        case .Text(value): assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
        case .Array(values): assert(false, "Asset parameter source must be an object");
    }
    assert(false, "Asset parameter was not found");
    return Value.Null;
}

pub AsInt :: (value: Value) -> int64 {
    switch value {
        case .Int(number): return number;
        case .UInt(number):
            assert(number <= 9223372036854775807, "Asset integer exceeds int64 range");
            return int64(number);
        case: assert(false, "Asset value must be an integer"); return 0;
    }
    assert(false, "Asset value must be an integer");
    return 0;
}

pub AsUInt :: (value: Value) -> uint64 {
    switch value {
        case .UInt(number): return number;
        case .Int(number):
            assert(number >= 0, "Asset unsigned integer must not be negative");
            return uint64(number);
        case: assert(false, "Asset value must be an unsigned integer"); return 0;
    }
    assert(false, "Asset value must be an unsigned integer");
    return 0;
}

pub AsReal :: (value: Value) -> double {
    switch value {
        case .Real(number): return number;
        case: assert(false, "Asset value must be real"); return 0.0;
    }
    assert(false, "Asset value must be real");
    return 0.0;
}

pub AsBool :: (value: Value) -> bool {
    switch value {
        case .Bool(flag): return flag;
        case: assert(false, "Asset value must be boolean"); return false;
    }
    assert(false, "Asset value must be boolean");
    return false;
}

pub AsText :: (value: Value) -> string {
    switch value {
        case .Text(text): return text;
        case: assert(false, "Asset value must be text"); return "";
    }
    assert(false, "Asset value must be text");
    return "";
}

MergeAt :: (base: Value, overlay: Value, depth: int) -> Value {
    assert(depth <= MaxDepth, "Asset overlay exceeds depth quota");
    switch base {
        case .Object(base_keys, base_values):
            assert(length(base_keys) == length(base_values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
            switch overlay {
                case .Object(keys, values):
                    assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
                    // Validate overlay keys before matching them, so a duplicate
                    // cannot disappear by replacing the same base key twice.
                    seen: string[] = [];
                    for (key in keys) {
                        for (previous in seen) { assert(previous != key, "Duplicate asset object field"); }
                        seen.append(key);
                    }
                    out: Field[] = [];
                    index: int = 0;
                    while (index < length(base_keys)) {
                        current := base_values[index];
                        added: int = 0;
                        while (added < length(keys)) {
                            if (keys[added] == base_keys[index]) {
                                current = MergeAt(current, values[added], depth + 1);
                            }
                            added += 1;
                        }
                        out.append(Field.Named(base_keys[index], current));
                        index += 1;
                    }
                    index = 0;
                    while (index < length(keys)) {
                        found: bool = false;
                        for (previous in base_keys) { if (previous == keys[index]) { found = true; } }
                        if (!found) { out.append(Field.Named(keys[index], values[index])); }
                        index += 1;
                    }
                    return Object(out);
                case: return overlay;
            }
        case: return overlay;
    }
    return overlay;
}

// Objects overlay recursively, keeping base key order and appending new keys in
// overlay order. Other values, including arrays, are replaced as complete values.
pub Merge :: (base: Value, overlay: Value) -> Value {
    return MergeAt(base, overlay, 0);
}

// Replace object members as complete values. This is the native component
// field contract: a supplied record field owns its entire reflected value.
ShallowObject :: (base: Value, overlay: Value) -> Value {
    switch base {
        case .Object(base_keys, base_values):
            assert(length(base_keys) == length(base_values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
            switch overlay {
                case .Object(keys, values):
                    assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
                    seen: string[] = [];
                    for (key in keys) {
                        for (previous in seen) { assert(previous != key, "Duplicate asset object field"); }
                        seen.append(key);
                    }
                    fields: Field[] = [];
                    index: int = 0;
                    while (index < length(base_keys)) {
                        value := base_values[index];
                        added: int = 0;
                        while (added < length(keys)) {
                            if (keys[added] == base_keys[index]) { value = values[added]; }
                            added += 1;
                        }
                        fields.append(Field.Named(base_keys[index], value));
                        index += 1;
                    }
                    index = 0;
                    while (index < length(keys)) {
                        found: bool = false;
                        for (previous in base_keys) { if (previous == keys[index]) { found = true; } }
                        if (!found) { fields.append(Field.Named(keys[index], values[index])); }
                        index += 1;
                    }
                    return Object(fields);
                case: assert(false, "Asset overlay must be an object"); return Value.Null;
            }
        case: assert(false, "Asset base must be an object"); return Value.Null;
    }
}

ObjectMember :: (object: Value, name: string) -> Value {
    switch object {
        case .Object(keys, values):
            assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
            index: int = 0;
            while (index < length(keys)) {
                if (keys[index] == name) { return values[index]; }
                index += 1;
            }
            return Object([]);
        case: assert(false, "Asset prototype must be an object"); return Value.Null;
    }
}

// Merge component names and their direct fields, replacing every supplied
// field as one value. A partial position record therefore does not inherit
// another axis from the base position; native decoding supplies its default.
pub OverrideComponents :: (base: Value, overlay: Value) -> Value {
    switch overlay {
        case .Object(keys, values):
            assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
            fields: Field[] = [];
            index: int = 0;
            while (index < length(keys)) {
                previous := ObjectMember(base, keys[index]);
                fields.append(Field.Named(keys[index], ShallowObject(previous, values[index])));
                index += 1;
            }
            return ShallowObject(base, Object(fields));
        case: assert(false, "Component overrides must be an object"); return Value.Null;
    }
}

// Root fields overlay shallowly. Components use their reflected whole-field
// replacement contract; parameters and explicit override metadata stay intact.
pub ApplyPrototype :: (base: Value, overlay: Value) -> Value {
    switch overlay {
        case .Object(keys, values):
            assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
            fields: Field[] = [];
            index: int = 0;
            while (index < length(keys)) {
                value := values[index];
                if (keys[index] == "components") {
                    value = OverrideComponents(ObjectMember(base, "components"), value);
                }
                fields.append(Field.Named(keys[index], value));
                index += 1;
            }
            return ShallowObject(base, Object(fields));
        case: assert(false, "Prototype overlay must be an object"); return Value.Null;
    }
}

MaxBytes: int : 16777216;
MaxValues: int : 1000000;
MaxDepth: int : 1024;

Work :: union { Visit(value: Value, depth: int) | Token(value: string) }

// Reject malformed UTF-8 rather than emitting bytes a strict JSON reader
// would interpret differently. Escaped source NULs cannot occur in C strings.
ValidText :: (bytes: int[]) -> bool {
    at: int = 0;
    while (at < length(bytes)) {
        first := bytes[at];
        if (first < 128) {
            at += 1;
            continue;
        }
        count: int = 0;
        low: int = 128;
        high: int = 191;
        if (first >= 194 && first <= 223) {
            count = 2;
        } else if (first >= 224 && first <= 239) {
            count = 3;
            if (first == 224) { low = 160; }
            if (first == 237) { high = 159; }
        } else if (first >= 240 && first <= 244) {
            count = 4;
            if (first == 240) { low = 144; }
            if (first == 244) { high = 143; }
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        if (count > length(bytes) - at || bytes[at + 1] < low || bytes[at + 1] > high) {
            return false;
        }
        index: int = 2;
        while (index < count) {
            if (bytes[at + index] < 128 || bytes[at + index] > 191) {
                return false;
            }
            index += 1;
        }
        at += count;
    }
    return true;
}

Quoted :: (text: string) -> byte[] {
    assert(strings.ByteLength(text) <= MaxBytes, "Asset text exceeds byte quota");
    bytes := strings.Bytes(text);
    assert(ValidText(bytes), "Asset text must be valid UTF-8");
    out: byte[] = [34];
    hex := strings.Bytes("0123456789abcdef");
    for (value in bytes) {
        if (value == 34 || value == 92) {
            assert(length(out) <= MaxBytes - 2, "Asset document exceeds byte quota");
            out.append(92);
            out.append(byte(value));
        } else if (value < 32) {
            assert(length(out) <= MaxBytes - 6, "Asset document exceeds byte quota");
            out.extend([92, 117, 48, 48, byte(hex[value >> 4]), byte(hex[value & 15])]);
        } else {
            assert(length(out) < MaxBytes, "Asset document exceeds byte quota");
            out.append(byte(value));
        }
    }
    assert(length(out) < MaxBytes, "Asset document exceeds byte quota");
    out.append(34);
    return out;
}

Raw :: (text: string) -> byte[] {
    out: byte[] = [];
    for (value in strings.Bytes(text)) {
        out.append(byte(value));
    }
    return out;
}

// JSON is the private native value transport. All structure, quoting, scalar
// conversion and quotas are authored here. No source text is parsed here.
// The caller's runtime instruction budget/cancellation also covers this code.
pub Encode :: (value: Value) -> byte[] {
    out: byte[] = [];
    pending: Work[] = [Work.Visit(value, 0)];
    visited: int = 0;
    while (length(pending) > 0) {
        work := pending[length(pending) - 1];
        pending.remove_index(length(pending) - 1);
        bytes: byte[] = [];
        switch work {
            case .Token(text):
                bytes = Raw(text);
            case .Visit(current, depth):
                assert(depth <= MaxDepth, "Asset document exceeds depth quota");
                visited += 1;
                assert(visited <= MaxValues, "Asset document exceeds value quota");
                switch current {
                    case .Null: bytes = Raw("null");
                    case .Bool(flag):
                        if (flag) { bytes = Raw("true"); } else { bytes = Raw("false"); }
                    case .Int(number): bytes = Raw(format_text("{}", number));
                    case .UInt(number): bytes = Raw(format_text("{}", number));
                    case .Real(number):
                        assert(number == number && number <= 1.7976931348623157e308 &&
                                   number >= -1.7976931348623157e308,
                               "Asset real values must be finite");
                        text := format_text("{:.17g}", number);
                        bytes = Raw(text);
                        // Preserve a real's representation when it is integral.
                        real: bool = false;
                        for (part in bytes) {
                            if (part == 46 || part == 101 || part == 69) { real = true; }
                        }
                        if (!real) { bytes.extend([46, 48]); }
                    case .Text(text): bytes = Quoted(text);
                    case .Array(values):
                        assert(length(values) <= MaxValues - visited, "Asset document exceeds value quota");
                        bytes = Raw("[");
                        pending.append(Work.Token("]"));
                        index := length(values) - 1;
                        while (index >= 0) {
                            pending.append(Work.Visit(values[index], depth + 1));
                            if (index > 0) { pending.append(Work.Token(",")); }
                            index -= 1;
                        }
                    case .Object(keys, values):
                        assert(length(keys) == length(values), "Asset object keys and values must match");
                        assert(length(values) <= MaxValues - visited, "Asset document exceeds value quota");
                        bytes = Raw("{");
                        pending.append(Work.Token("}"));
                        index := length(values) - 1;
                        while (index >= 0) {
                            previous: int = 0;
                            while (previous < index) {
                                assert(keys[previous] != keys[index], "Duplicate asset object field");
                                previous += 1;
                            }
                            pending.append(Work.Visit(values[index], depth + 1));
                            pending.append(Work.Token(":"));
                            pending.append(Work.Visit(Value.Text(keys[index]), depth + 1));
                            if (index > 0) { pending.append(Work.Token(",")); }
                            index -= 1;
                        }
                }
        }
        assert(length(bytes) <= MaxBytes - length(out), "Asset document exceeds byte quota");
        out.extend(bytes);
    }
    return out;
}

// String operations compare, count and offset bytes.
// Spaces and case use ASCII. Offsets are byte offsets, and -1 means not found.

// Compiler text operations use bytes, including bytes inside UTF-8 sequences.
pub ByteLength :: (value: string) -> int {
    return text_byte_length(value);
}

// Returns -1 outside the string; valid bytes are unsigned values from 0 to 255.
// Each call measures the string, so a loop over a long one should read Bytes.
pub ByteAt :: (value: string, index: int) -> int {
    return text_byte_at(value, index);
}

// Every byte of the string, from 0 to 255, read in one pass.
pub Bytes :: (value: string) -> int[] {
    return text_bytes(value);
}

// Start clamps to the string and count clamps to its remaining bytes.
pub Slice :: (value: string, start: int, count: int) -> string {
    return text_slice(value, start, count);
}

pub Compare :: (left: string, right: string) -> int {
    leftLength := ByteLength(left);
    rightLength := ByteLength(right);
    index: int = 0;
    while (index < leftLength && index < rightLength) {
        a := ByteAt(left, index);
        b := ByteAt(right, index);
        if (a < b) {
            return -1;
        }
        if (a > b) {
            return 1;
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    if (leftLength < rightLength) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (leftLength > rightLength) {
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

pub IsIdentifier :: (value: string) -> bool {
    size := ByteLength(value);
    if (size == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    index: int = 0;
    while (index < size) {
        byte := ByteAt(value, index);
        letter := byte == 95 || (byte >= 65 && byte <= 90) || (byte >= 97 && byte <= 122);
        if (!letter && !(index > 0 && byte >= 48 && byte <= 57)) {
            return false;
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    return true;
}

pub BaseName :: (path: string) -> string {
    size := ByteLength(path);
    start: int = 0;
    index: int = 0;
    while (index < size) {
        if (ByteAt(path, index) == 47) {
            start = index + 1;
        }
        index += 1;
    }

pub Contains :: (s: string, substr: string) -> bool {
    return Index(s, substr) >= 0;
}

pub ContainsAny :: (s: string, chars: string) -> bool {
    return IndexAny(s, chars) >= 0;
}

pub HasPrefix :: (s: string, prefix: string) -> bool {
    size := ByteLength(prefix);
    return ByteLength(s) >= size && Slice(s, 0, size) == prefix;
}

pub HasSuffix :: (s: string, suffix: string) -> bool {
    size := ByteLength(s);
    count := ByteLength(suffix);
    return size >= count && Slice(s, size - count, count) == suffix;
}

pub IndexByte :: (s: string, c: int) -> int {
    size := ByteLength(s);
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < size) {
        if (ByteAt(s, i) == c) {
            return i;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    return -1;
}

pub LastIndexByte :: (s: string, c: int) -> int {
    i: int = ByteLength(s) - 1;
    while (i >= 0) {

            return i;

        i -= 1;
    }
    return -1;
}

// Uses a 32-bit Rabin-Karp rolling hash. An empty substring is found at 0.
pub Index :: (s: string, substr: string) -> int {
    n := ByteLength(substr);
    size := ByteLength(s);
    if (n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return IndexByte(s, ByteAt(substr, 0));
    }
    if (n == size) {
        if (s == substr) {
            return 0;
        }
        return -1;
    }
    if (n > size) {
        return -1;
    }
    hash: int64 = 0;
    pow: int64 = 1;
    h: int64 = 0;
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        hash = (hash * 16777619 + ByteAt(substr, i)) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        pow = (pow * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        h = (h * 16777619 + ByteAt(s, i)) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        i += 1;
    }
    if (h == hash && Slice(s, 0, n) == substr) {
        return 0;
    }
    while (i < size) {
        h = (h * 16777619 + ByteAt(s, i) - pow * ByteAt(s, i - n)) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        i += 1;
        if (h == hash && Slice(s, i - n, n) == substr) {
            return i - n;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

// Index's search from the end. An empty substring is found at the length of s.
pub LastIndex :: (s: string, substr: string) -> int {
    n := ByteLength(substr);
    size := ByteLength(s);
    if (n == 0) {
        return size;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return LastIndexByte(s, ByteAt(substr, 0));
    }
    if (n == size) {
        if (s == substr) {
            return 0;
        }
        return -1;
    }
    if (n > size) {
        return -1;
    }
    hash: int64 = 0;
    pow: int64 = 1;
    h: int64 = 0;
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        hash = (hash * 16777619 + ByteAt(substr, n - 1 - i)) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        pow = (pow * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        h = (h * 16777619 + ByteAt(s, size - 1 - i)) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        i += 1;
    }
    i = size - n;
    if (h == hash && Slice(s, i, n) == substr) {
        return i;
    }
    i -= 1;
    while (i >= 0) {
        h = (h * 16777619 + ByteAt(s, i) - pow * ByteAt(s, i + n)) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        if (h == hash && Slice(s, i, n) == substr) {
            return i;
        }
        i -= 1;
    }
    return -1;
}

// The offset of the first byte of s that is any byte of chars.
pub IndexAny :: (s: string, chars: string) -> int {
    size := ByteLength(s);
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < size) {
        if (IndexByte(chars, ByteAt(s, i)) >= 0) {
            return i;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    return -1;
}

pub LastIndexAny :: (s: string, chars: string) -> int {
    i: int = ByteLength(s) - 1;
    while (i >= 0) {
        if (IndexByte(chars, ByteAt(s, i)) >= 0) {
            return i;
        }
        i -= 1;
    }
    return -1;
}

// Non-overlapping occurrences. An empty substring occurs at every byte
// boundary, one more than the byte length.
pub Count :: (s: string, substr: string) -> int {
    n := ByteLength(substr);
    if (n == 0) {
        return ByteLength(s) + 1;
    }
    total: int = 0;
    if (n == 1) {
        c := ByteAt(substr, 0);
        size := ByteLength(s);
        i: int = 0;
        while (i < size) {
            if (ByteAt(s, i) == c) {
                total += 1;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        return total;
    }
    rest: string = s;
    i := Index(rest, substr);
    while (i >= 0) {
        total += 1;
        rest = Slice(rest, i + n, ByteLength(rest));
        i = Index(rest, substr);
    }
    return total;
}

pub TruncateToByte :: (s: string, c: int) -> string {
    n := IndexByte(s, c);

    return Slice(s, 0, n);

pub EqualFold :: (u: string, v: string) -> bool {
    size := ByteLength(u);
    if (size != ByteLength(v)) {
        return false;
    }
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < size) {
        sr := ByteAt(u, i);
        tr := ByteAt(v, i);
        if (tr < sr) {
            swap := sr;
            sr = tr;
            tr = swap;
        }
        if (tr != sr && !(sr >= 65 && sr <= 90 && tr == sr + 32)) {
            return false;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    return true;
}

    start: int = 0;
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < size) {
        c := ByteAt(s, i);
        if (c >= 65 && c <= 90) {
            letter := Slice("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", c - 65, 1);
            result = format_text("{}{}{}", result, Slice(s, start, i - start), letter);
            start = i + 1;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    if (start == 0) {
        return s;
    }
    return format_text("{}{}", result, Slice(s, start, size - start));

pub TrimLeft :: (s: string, cutset: string) -> string {
    size := ByteLength(s);

pub TrimRight :: (s: string, cutset: string) -> string {
    i := ByteLength(s);

    return Slice(s, 0, i);

    size := ByteLength(s);
    i: int = 0;

pub TrimRightSpace :: (s: string) -> string {
    i := ByteLength(s);
    while (i > 0 && IsAsciiSpace(ByteAt(s, i - 1))) {

    return Slice(s, 0, i);

pub TrimSpace :: (s: string) -> string {

pub TrimPrefix :: (s: string, prefix: string) -> string {

// An offset outside s keeps all of s. A count past the end keeps the rest.
pub Cut :: (s: string, offset: int, count: int) -> string {
    rest: string = s;
    size := ByteLength(s);
    if (offset >= 0 && offset < size) {
        rest = Slice(s, offset, size - offset);
    }
    if (count < 1 || count >= ByteLength(rest)) {
        return rest;
    }
    return Slice(rest, 0, count);

// Produces at most n parts, or every part when n is negative.
// The last part holds the rest of s. Each other part keeps the first keep
// bytes of the separator after it. An empty separator splits s into bytes.
SplitKeeping :: (s: string, sep: string, keep: int, n: int) -> string[] {
    parts: string[] = [];
    size := ByteLength(sep);
    limit := n;
    if (size == 0) {
        count := ByteLength(s);
        if (limit < 0 || limit > count) {
            limit = count;
        }
        while (length(parts) < limit - 1) {
            parts.append(Slice(s, length(parts), 1));
        }
        if (limit > 0) {
            parts.append(Slice(s, limit - 1, count));

    if (limit == 0) {
        return parts;
    }
    if (limit < 0) {
        limit = Count(s, sep) + 1;

        parts.append(Slice(rest, 0, m + keep));
        rest = Slice(rest, m + size, ByteLength(rest));

// The runs of bytes between ASCII spaces.
pub Fields :: (s: string) -> string[] {
    fields: string[] = [];
    size := ByteLength(s);
    start: int = -1;
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < size) {
        if (IsAsciiSpace(ByteAt(s, i))) {
            if (start >= 0) {
                fields.append(Slice(s, start, i - start));
                start = -1;
            }
        } else if (start < 0) {
            start = i;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    if (start >= 0) {
        fields.append(Slice(s, start, size - start));
    }
    return fields;

pub Join :: (a: string[], sep: string) -> string {
    if (length(a) == 0) {
        return "";

    result: string = a[0];
    i: int = 1;
    while (i < length(a)) {
        result = format_text("{}{}{}", result, sep, a[i]);
        i += 1;
    }
    return result;

pub Repeat :: (s: string, count: int) -> string {
    if (count < 1) {
        return "";
    }
    total: int64 = int64(ByteLength(s)) * count;
    result: string = s;
    while (ByteLength(result) < total) {
        rest: int64 = total - ByteLength(result);
        result = format_text("{}{}", result, Slice(result, 0, int(clamp: rest)));
    }
    return result;
}

// Replaces the first n non-overlapping matches of old, or all of them when n is
// negative. An empty old matches at every byte boundary.
pub Replace :: (s: string, old: string, new: string, n: int) -> string {
    if (old == new || n == 0) {
        return s;
    }
    matches := Count(s, old);
    if (matches == 0) {
        return s;
    }
    if (n > 0 && n < matches) {
        matches = n;
    }
    size := ByteLength(s);
    width := ByteLength(old);
    result: string = "";
    start: int = 0;
    i: int = 0;
    while (i < matches) {
        j := start;
        if (width == 0) {
            if (i > 0) {
                j += 1;
            }
        } else {
            j += Index(Slice(s, start, size - start), old);
        }
        result = format_text("{}{}{}", result, Slice(s, start, j - start), new);
        start = j + width;
        i += 1;
    }
    return format_text("{}{}", result, Slice(s, start, size - start));
}

pub ReplaceAll :: (s: string, old: string, new: string) -> string {
    return Replace(s, old, new, -1);
}

pub Remove :: (s: string, key: string, n: int) -> string {
    return Replace(s, key, "", n);
}

pub RemoveAll :: (s: string, key: string) -> string {
    return Remove(s, key, -1);
}

pub Parts :: struct {
    head: string;
    match: string;
    tail: string;
}

// The text before the first sep, sep and the text after it; when sep is
// absent, head is all of str and the others are empty.
pub Partition :: (str: string, sep: string) -> Parts {
    i := Index(str, sep);
    if (i < 0) {
        return {head: str, match: "", tail: ""};
    }
    size := ByteLength(sep);
    return {head: Slice(str, 0, i), match: sep, tail: Slice(str, i + size, ByteLength(str))};
}

// Family constructors type the stable document fields. Extension fields retain
// engine-specific reflected values and optional settings; Object rejects a
// duplicate of a required field. Runtime catalog validators own native names.
TextList :: (items: string[]) -> Value {
    values: Value[] = [];
    for (item in items) { values.append(Value.Text(item)); }
    return List(values);
}

NamedObject :: (required: Field[], additional: Field[]) -> Value {
    required.extend(additional);
    return Object(required);
}

pub Project :: (name: string, version: int, content: string, start_scene: string, fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    assert(name != "", "Project name must not be empty");
    assert(version > 0, "Project version must be positive");
    assert(content != "", "Project content path must not be empty");
    return NamedObject([Field.Named("name", Value.Text(name)), Field.Named("version", Value.Int(int64(version))),
                        Field.Named("content", Value.Text(content)), Field.Named("start_scene", Value.Text(start_scene))], fields);
}

pub Application :: (title: string, width: int, height: int, fullscreen: bool, fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    assert(width >= 0 && height >= 0 && width <= 16384 && height <= 16384,
           "Application dimensions must be between 0 and 16384");
    return NamedObject([Field.Named("title", Value.Text(title)), Field.Named("width", Value.Int(int64(width))),

}

pub EntityDefinition :: union {
    Named(name: string, base_name: string, components: Field[], fields: Field[])
}

EntityValue :: (entity: EntityDefinition) -> Value {
    switch entity {
        case .Named(name, base_name, components, fields):
            assert(name != "", "Scene entity name must not be empty");
            return NamedObject([Field.Named("name", Value.Text(name)), Field.Named("prototype", Value.Text(base_name)),
                                Field.Named("components", Object(components))], fields);
    }
}

pub Scene :: (name: string, entities: EntityDefinition[], fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    assert(name != "", "Scene name must not be empty");
    values: Value[] = [];
    names: string[] = [];
    for (entity in entities) {
        switch entity {
            case .Named(entity_name, base_name, components, extra):
                for (previous in names) { assert(previous != entity_name, "Duplicate scene entity name"); }
                names.append(entity_name);
        }
        values.append(EntityValue(entity));
    }
    return NamedObject([Field.Named("version", Value.Int(1)), Field.Named("name", Value.Text(name)),
                        Field.Named("entities", List(values))], fields);
}

pub Prototype :: (name: string, components: Field[], includes: string[], behaviors: string[], fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    assert(name != "", "Prototype name must not be empty");
    return NamedObject([Field.Named("name", Value.Text(name)), Field.Named("components", Object(components)),
                        Field.Named("includes", TextList(includes)), Field.Named("behaviors", TextList(behaviors))], fields);
}

pub GraphNode :: union { Named(id: uint64, type: string, fields: Field[]) }
pub GraphConnection :: union {
    Named(from: string, to: string, fields: Field[])
    | Linked(from: uint64, from_pin: uint64, to: uint64, to_pin: uint64, fields: Field[])
}
pub GraphDefinition :: union { Named(kind: string, name: string, nodes: GraphNode[], edges: GraphConnection[], fields: Field[]) }

GraphValue :: (graph: GraphDefinition) -> Value {
    switch graph {
        case .Named(kind, name, nodes, edges, fields):
            assert(kind != "", "Graph kind must not be empty");
            values: Value[] = [];
            ids: uint64[] = [];
            for (node in nodes) {
                switch node {
                    case .Named(id, type, extra):
                        assert(type != "", "Graph node needs a type");
                        for (previous in ids) { assert(previous != id, "Duplicate graph node ID"); }
                        ids.append(id);
                        values.append(NamedObject([Field.Named("id", Value.UInt(id)),
                                                   Field.Named("type", Value.Text(type))], extra));
                }
            }
            links: Value[] = [];
            for (edge in edges) {
                switch edge {
                    case .Named(from, to, extra):
                        assert(from != "" && to != "", "Graph edge needs two pin references");
                        links.append(NamedObject([Field.Named("from", Value.Text(from)),
                                                  Field.Named("to", Value.Text(to))], extra));
                    case .Linked(from, from_pin, to, to_pin, extra):
                        links.append(NamedObject([Field.Named("from", Value.UInt(from)), Field.Named("from_pin", Value.UInt(from_pin)),
                                                  Field.Named("to", Value.UInt(to)), Field.Named("to_pin", Value.UInt(to_pin))], extra));
                }
            }
            return NamedObject([Field.Named("kind", Value.Text(kind)), Field.Named("name", Value.Text(name)),
                                Field.Named("nodes", List(values)), Field.Named("edges", List(links))], fields);
    }
}

pub Graph :: (name: string, domain: string, version: int, id_counter: uint64, graphs: GraphDefinition[], fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    assert(name != "" && domain != "", "Graph asset needs a name and domain");
    assert(version > 0, "Graph version must be positive");
    values: Value[] = [];
    for (graph in graphs) { values.append(GraphValue(graph)); }
    return NamedObject([Field.Named("name", Value.Text(name)), Field.Named("domain", Value.Text(domain)),
                        Field.Named("version", Value.Int(int64(version))), Field.Named("id_counter", Value.UInt(id_counter)),
                        Field.Named("graphs", List(values))], fields);
}

pub InputAction :: union {
    Keyboard(name: string, sources: string[], firing: bool)
    | Controller(name: string, slot: int, buttons: string[], firing: bool)
    | Combined(name: string, sources: string[], slot: int, buttons: string[], firing: bool)
}

pub InputMap :: (actions: InputAction[]) -> Value {
    fields: Field[] = [];
    for (input in actions) {
        switch input {
            case .Keyboard(name, sources, firing):
                assert(name != "" && length(sources) > 0, "Keyboard action needs a name and sources");
                fields.append(Field.Named(name, Object([Field.Named("sources", TextList(sources)),
                                                        Field.Named("firing", Value.Bool(firing))])));
            case .Controller(name, slot, buttons, firing):
                assert(name != "" && length(buttons) > 0 && slot >= 0 && slot < 4,
                       "Controller action needs a name, buttons and slot from 0 to 3");
                fields.append(Field.Named(name, Object([Field.Named("controller", Value.Int(int64(slot))),
                                                        Field.Named("buttons", TextList(buttons)), Field.Named("firing", Value.Bool(firing))])));
            case .Combined(name, sources, slot, buttons, firing):
                assert(name != "" && length(sources) > 0 && length(buttons) > 0 && slot >= 0 && slot < 4,
                       "Combined action needs a name, sources, buttons and slot from 0 to 3");
                fields.append(Field.Named(name, Object([Field.Named("sources", TextList(sources)),
                                                        Field.Named("controller", Value.Int(int64(slot))),
                                                        Field.Named("buttons", TextList(buttons)), Field.Named("firing", Value.Bool(firing))])));
        }
    }
    return Object(fields);
}

pub Keyframe :: union { At(frame: int, fields: Field[]) }

pub Scenario :: (scene: string, frames: int, keys: Keyframe[], fields: Field[]) -> Value {
    assert(scene != "" && frames > 0 && frames <= 108000, "Scenario needs a scene and 1 to 108000 frames");
    values: Value[] = [];
    previous: int = -1;
    for (key in keys) {
        switch key {
            case .At(frame, extra):
                assert(frame >= 0 && frame < frames && frame >= previous, "Scenario key frames must not decrease or exceed the scenario");
                previous = frame;
                values.append(NamedObject([Field.Named("frame", Value.Int(int64(frame)))], extra));
        }
    }
    return NamedObject([Field.Named("scene", Value.Text(scene)), Field.Named("frames", Value.Int(int64(frames))),
                        Field.Named("keys", List(values))], fields);
}

pub ComponentDisplay :: union { Named(name: string, tab: string, icon: string, fields: Field[]) }

pub ComponentPresentation :: (components: ComponentDisplay[]) -> Value {
    entries: Field[] = [];
    for (component in components) {
        switch component {
            case .Named(name, tab, icon, fields):
                assert(name != "", "Component presentation needs a name");
                display: Field[] = [];
                if (tab != "") {
                    assert(tab == "Object" || tab == "Physics" || tab == "Material" || tab == "Gameplay",
                           "Unknown component presentation tab");
                    display.append(Field.Named("tab", Value.Text(tab)));
                }
                if (icon != "") { display.append(Field.Named("icon", Value.Text(icon))); }
                entries.append(Field.Named(name, NamedObject(display, fields)));
        }
    }
    return Object([Field.Named("components", Object(entries))]);
}
